simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מְרִיא (H4806) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 8 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מְרִיא (mᵉrîyʼ) means stall-fed ; often (as noun) a beeve First listed occurrence: 1Kgs 1 9.

definitions.full: H4806. meri מְרִיא noun [masculine] fatling, fatlings ; — absolute ׳מ 2Sam 6:13 3 t.; plural absolute מְרִיאִים Isa 1:11 , construct מְרִיאֵי Ezek 39:18 ; suffix מְרִיאֵיכֶם Amos 5:22 ; — fatling: וּמְרִיא וּכְפִיר עֵגֶל Isa 11:6 ; elsewhere only of sacrificial animals, מְרִיאֵיכֶם שֶׁלָם Amos 5:22 (|| מִנְחֹתֵיכֶם עֹלוֺת, ); מְרִיאִים חֵלֶב Isa 1:11 (|| מָּרִים דַּם אֵלִים, עֹלוֺת , etc); בָשָׁן מְרִיאֵי Ezek 39:18 (+ אֵילִים פָרִים, , etc.); also singular collective, וּמְדִיא שׁוֺר וַיִּןבָּח 2Sam 6:13 , so (+ וּבָקָר צאֹן ) 1Kin 1:9 , and (+ צאֹן שׁוֺר, ) 1:19 ; 1:25 .
definitions.rootNote: from 4754 in the sense of grossness , through the idea of domineering (compare 4756 );
